run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T01:05:16Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend-proxy RequestErrorRate alert is dominated by a sustained error burst that begins around 01:15–01:17 and is confined to the checkout path. In the sampled metric series, frontend-proxy ingress ERROR spans rose from ~0–0.02/s (00:55–01:15) to 0.44–0.56/s (01:17–01:23), and every frontend error span in the 28-minute increase window is on POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (322, 322, 322, 322 occurrences; all other frontend operations 0). frontend-proxy's own access logs show "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream while other routes returned 200. The checkout workload is the failing dependency: Deployment checkout was re-rolled at 01:13:54 with a new ReplicaSet whose only template difference from the previous ReplicaSet is KAFKA_ADDR changed from kafka:9092 to kafka:9999 (same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout). The new checkout container logs repeated "Failed to connect to broker kafka:9999: dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout" and "kafka: client has run out of available brokers to talk to", and the container terminated with exitCode 2 (Error) at 01:17:32 and 01:20:59; the pod is Ready=False with restartCount 1 and the checkout Service Endpoints list only notReadyAddresses. The kafka Service exposes only 9092/9093 and its ready endpoint is on 9092, so kafka:9999 matches no exposed port. All flagd fault-injection flags in ConfigMap flagd-config are off, so flag-based fault injection is not supported by the evidence. Two things keep the conclusion partial: the alert's stated start (01:05:16) coincides with a small earlier episode of frontend-proxy 503 "upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}" responses on GET /api/products/* and /api/recommendations?productIds=* between 00:57:11 and 01:03:46, before the checkout rollout, whose cause I could not attribute; and the RequestErrorRate rule itself is not present in the queried Prometheus, so its expression and the annotation value 1.7333 could not be verified.

claims.text: frontend-proxy span series show STATUS_CODE_ERROR on span_name=ingress and span_name="router frontend egress": 5-minute error rate 0 at 00:55, 0.0074 at 01:00, 0.0111 at 01:05, 0.0111 at 01:10, 0.0222 at 01:15, then 0.5630 at 01:20 and 0.4106 at 01:25 (ingress), with total ingress span rate ~9–10.6/s over the same points.

A finer 2-minute-rate view of frontend-proxy ingress ERROR spans shows small nonzero values at 00:59 (0.0333), 01:01 (0.0111), 01:03 (0.0222), 01:13 (0.0111), 01:15 (0.0333), then a sustained rise to 0.4444 at 01:17, 0.4556 at 01:19, 0.30 at 01:21 and 0.5111 at 01:23.

In the 01:00–01:28 increase window, frontend's ERROR-status spans are exclusively checkout operations: POST 321.96, POST /api/checkout 321.96, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 322.04, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 322.04, and frontend tcp.connect 35.44; frontend's other operations (GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart) increased by 0.

frontend's client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder had ERROR rate 0 at every 2-minute sample from 00:57 through 01:15, then 0.4222 at 01:17, 0.4444 at 01:19, 0.2889 at 01:21 and 0.5444 at 01:23.

frontend-proxy access logs contain "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream entries at 2026-11-18T01:22:20.042Z and 01:22:20.501Z and 01:22:20.745Z, interleaved with 200 responses for /api/cart, /api/products/*, /api/data and /api/recommendations.

Pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz has container checkout with restartCount 1, ready=false, ContainersNotReady; its current instance terminated at 2026-11-18T01:20:59Z with exitCode 2 reason Error and its lastState terminated at 01:17:32Z with exitCode 2 reason Error.

The checkout container logs (01:13:56–01:22:15) show "client/metadata fetching metadata for all topics from broker kafka:9999", repeated "Failed to connect to broker kafka:9999: dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout", "client/metadata no available broker to send metadata request to", "kafka: client has run out of available brokers to talk to: dial tcp 100.66.162.182:9999: i/o timeout", and the service config line "kafkaBrokerSvcAddr:kafka:9999".

Deployment checkout's pod template sets KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999. ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (created 2026-11-18T00:40:36Z, spec.replicas 0) sets KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9092, while ReplicaSet checkout-849d65649b (created 2026-11-18T01:13:54Z, spec.replicas 1) sets KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999; both use image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, and a full env comparison of the two templates shows KAFKA_ADDR is the only differing variable.

Events for Deployment checkout: ScalingReplicaSet at 2026-11-18T01:13:54Z "Scaled up replica set checkout-849d65649b from 0 to 1", ReplicaSet checkout-849d65649b SuccessfulCreate of pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz at 01:13:54Z, ScalingReplicaSet "Scaled down replica set checkout-5dccddf8bb from 1 to 0" at 01:13:57Z and Killing of pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9d9c8 at 01:13:57Z; a Warning BackOff event at 01:21:00Z reports "Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz_otel-demo".

The kafka Service exposes only ports plaintext 9092 and controller 9093, and its Endpoints have a ready address (kafka-ff7884766-ntckh, 100.96.4.148) on 9092/9093; the kafka Deployment env is KAFKA_LISTENERS=PLAINTEXT://:9092,CONTROLLER://:9093 and KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS=PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092, while sibling workloads accounting and fraud-detection use KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9092.
The checkout Service Endpoints contain no ready addresses, only notReadyAddresses for pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz at 100.96.4.175 on port 8080.

checkout's span series exist only with status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET (9 series: HTTP POST, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart, orders publish, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder), and checkout's overall span rate fell from 8.04/s at 01:15 to 0 at 01:20 and 0 at 01:25, so checkout emits no ERROR-status spans and its failure is visible only in its logs, pod state and span disappearance.

Span rates of checkout's downstream callees collapse at the same time: email 2.34/s (01:15) to 0.0148/s (01:20), payment 1.16/s to 0.0074/s, shipping 1.77/s to 0.0111/s, currency 1.72/s to 0.0148/s, cart 16.30/s to 10.60/s, product-catalog 10.43/s to 8.29/s.

Pod checkout-849d65649b-qqtsz started 2026-11-18T01:13:54Z (owner checkout-849d65649b) with restartCount 1 and READY=false, whereas frontend-675fd7b5c5-n4sbv, frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-h7j7c, kafka-ff7884766-ntckh and the other otel-demo pods show restartCount 0 and READY=true.

Before the checkout rollout, frontend-proxy logged 503 responses with response flag "UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}" on GET /api/products/66VCHSJNUP at 00:57:11 and 00:57:38, GET /api/products/LS4PSXUNUM at 00:58:51, GET /api/products/L9ECAV7KIM at 01:00:11, GET /api/products/9SIQT8TOJO at 01:00:44, GET /api/recommendations?productIds=9SIQT8TOJO at 01:00:45 and GET /api/recommendations?productIds=HQTGWGPNH4 at 01:03:46.

The Jaeger sample for frontend returned spans whose source timestamps are 2026-11-18T01:02:42–01:02:43 with HTTP 200 and rpc.grpc.status_code 0 on the checkout, cart, product-catalog, recommendation and ad calls, so the sampled traces do not cover the 01:15–01:29 error period.

The chain from the checkout Deployment's KAFKA_ADDR=kafka:9999 to the alert is: checkout cannot reach a broker on port 9999, its PlaceOrder handling terminates the process (exitCode 2), the pod stays NotReady so the checkout Service has no ready endpoint, frontend's POST /api/checkout call fails and frontend returns 500, and frontend-proxy records the 500 as ingress/egress ERROR spans. The propagation from checkout unavailability to the frontend 500 is inferred from matching timing and call path, because no PlaceOrder error-detail span was captured.

The 503 upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} responses between 00:57:11 and 01:03:46 on GET /api/products/* and /api/recommendations are a separate, earlier frontend-side transient that is not explained by the checkout configuration change (which happened at 01:13:54); it is the closest signal to the alert's stated start of 01:05:16, and its cause remains unattributed.

All 12 flags in ConfigMap flagd-config have defaultVariant "off" (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure), so no flagd fault-injection flag was switched on at query time.

A kafka broker outage is not what the evidence shows: the kafka Service and its ready Endpoints expose 9092/9093 and the broker advertises PLAINTEXT://kafka:9092, while checkout's failures are dial timeouts to port 9999, a port no Service or listener exposes.

The alert being driven by frontend-proxy's own capacity or restart problem is not supported: pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-h7j7c is Running/READY with restartCount 0, and its error spans are limited to ingress and "router frontend egress" spans on requests that frontend answered with 500, with no restart or OOM evidence for the proxy.

Restore the checkout Deployment's KAFKA_ADDR to kafka:9092 (the value used by the previous ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb and by accounting and fraud-detection), which should let the checkout container start without "kafka: client has run out of available brokers", keep the pod Ready, and restore the checkout Service endpoint; then confirm checkout span rate and frontend POST /api/checkout 500 rate return to their pre-01:13 levels.

gaps: The alerting rule RequestErrorRate was not found in the queried Prometheus: list_prometheus_rules returned nothing for rule_name=RequestErrorRate and nothing for type=alert, so the rule's expression and the annotation value "current: 1.7333333333333332" could not be verified and the alert's start at 01:05:16Z could not be tied to a specific onset of the sampled error series.
No frontend container log lines were available for 01:16–01:25 (0 bytes read) and no previous frontend instance existed, so the exact error text/log for the frontend 500 on /api/checkout is unknown.
The previous checkout container instance's logs were reported as not found (HTTP 400), so the crash output of the 01:13:56–01:17:32 instance is unknown; only its exitCode 2 is observed.
Jaeger returned no spans after 2026-11-18T01:02:43Z, so span-level error details (e.g. the gRPC status/message on grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) for the 01:15–01:29 failures are unknown.
Prometheus returned samples for the frontend-proxy error series only from 00:55 to 01:25, so there is no pre-incident baseline; whether the 00:57–01:03 503 blips are unusual cannot be established.

Who or what changed the checkout Deployment pod template (KAFKA_ADDR kafka:9092 → kafka:9999) at 01:13:54Z is unknown; the change_history integration is not available in this Run, so only the ReplicaSet creation timestamps and template difference are observed.

The cause of the 00:57:11–01:03:46 503 upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} responses on GET /api/products/* and /api/recommendations is not attributed; frontend logs and span data for that period give no error detail.

http_server_request_duration_seconds_count and rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count / rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count returned no data in this target, so HTTP status-code and gRPC-status breakdowns beyond traces_span_metrics_calls_total are unknown.

Services cart, currency, product-catalog, email, shipping, payment, quote, accounting, ad, fraud-detection and recommendation were not shown to be failing by their own error evidence, but their health was not established independently; the drop in their span rates is consistent with their caller checkout ceasing to call them and is not evidence about them.
kafka's own application logs were not read; the evidence about kafka is limited to its Service ports, ready Endpoints and Deployment listener configuration.
next_steps: Identify the actor/pipeline that changed Deployment checkout's KAFKA_ADDR to kafka:9999 at 2026-11-18T01:13:54Z (CI/Helm value, manual edit) using cluster audit history, which is not available in this Run.

Review the source of the RequestErrorRate alert rule outside this Prometheus to confirm its expression and the reported current value, and reconcile the stated firing time 01:05:16Z with the observed error series.

Investigate the pre-rollout 503 upstream_reset episode (00:57–01:03) on frontend's /api/products and /api/recommendations paths, including frontend application logs and request timeouts, to decide whether it is a separate defect.
After restoring the KAFKA_ADDR value, verify checkout pod readiness, checkout span rate recovery, and that frontend-proxy ingress 500s on POST /api/checkout stop.
